title: Tagged key leaf

forms: key CHECKSIGVERIFY, then a short push
key CHECKSIGVERIFY, key CHECKSIGVERIFY, then a short push

note: The check matches one or two 32-byte keys and CHECKSIGVERIFY followed by a push of 1 to 32 bytes, or one 32-byte key, CHECKSIG, IF, a push of 1 to 32 bytes, ENDIF. It does not copy a data-byte count. Not an insert package.
